name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-2-yoshi-s-island-title-screen-world
title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island - Title Screen (World 6)
description:
The 2bpp background of the title screen / castle destruction cutscene of Yoshi's Island when you have reached world 6, converted into a 64x64 tilemap made out of 8x8 tiles and otherwise taken straight out of the game.

Note that in order to display this background properly, a custom status bar is recommend.
That being said, with some HDMA to cover the cutoff, you also are able to also use a vanilla Status Bar since the background is located at the bottom half of the tilemap.
